primitives.name: Content Draft Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: The platform's `ContentDraft` > engine drafts internally; the legacy content-publishing worker is hard-gated > off by default.
primitives.assumptions: Drafts are isolated from live publishing until explicit promotion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Hard gate prevents accidental publication during calibration.

layer2.mapping: Content draft state \( D \) evolves under \( \mathcal{F} \)-measurable constraints, modeled as \( D(t) = \mathcal{F}(D(t-1), \mathcal{B}(t)) \).
layer2.telemetry: Draft count and internal publish delay metrics.

primitives.name: Boundary Guard
primitives.verbatim_quote: The boundary guard is `scripts/guardrails/api-v1-boundary.mjs`, and it blocks accidental live API v1 routes, Prisma models, migrations, env vars, database imports, provider calls, and network calls until an owner-approved promotion exists.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{B}(t)': 'guardrail state at time t', '\\mathcal{P}(t)': 'promotion approval flag'}
primitives.assumptions: Guardrail enforces conditional access control based on promotion state.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if \( \mathcal{P}(t) \) is bypassed or misconfigured.

layer2.mapping: API access \( \mathcal{A}(t) \) is isomorphic to \( \mathcal{B}(t) \times \mathcal{P}(t) \), where \( \mathcal{A}(t) = \mathcal{B}(t) \cdot \mathcal{P}(t) \).
layer2.telemetry: Blocked API call count and promotion approval logs.

primitives.verbatim_quote: ## FABLE/NFL evidence layer The repo-visible FABLE/NFL evidence layer lives in `docs/fable/`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{E}(t)': 'evidence vector at time t', 'e_i(t)': 'individual evidence item', '\\mathcal{F}': 'feature space'}
primitives.assumptions: Evidence is structured in \( \mathcal{F} \) for probabilistic modeling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Evidence corruption or misalignment leads to invalid \( P(H|E) \).

layer2.mapping: Evidence layer \( \mathcal{E}(t) \) is kernel-derived from \( \mathcal{F} \) and used in \( P(H|E) \) inference.
layer2.telemetry: Evidence completeness score and feature alignment metrics.

The system's operational structure is defined by a triadic readiness regime: internal calibration, production deployment, and public exposure. The Content Draft Engine ensures that all content remains isolated until promoted, enforcing a temporal separation between drafting and publishing. The Boundary Guard acts as a probabilistic filter, blocking unauthorized API access unless a promotion flag is active, thereby creating a conditional state transition governed by \( \mathcal{B}(t) \times \mathcal{P}(t) \). The FABLE/NFL Evidence Layer provides a structured feature space \( \mathcal{F} \) for Bayesian inference, ensuring that predictions are grounded in verifiable data. Each primitive operates within a dual constraint: one of logical isolation (drafting, guarding) and one of empirical grounding (evidence). Failure modes arise from bypassing these guards or misaligning evidence features, which can lead to incorrect inference or unauthorized access. The system's robustness depends on maintaining these dualities through strict adherence to \( \mathcal{F} \)-measurable constraints.
